## HEIDMAR MARITIME HOLDINGS CORP. EXPANDS SHIP MANAGEMENT PLATFORM


July 7, 2026


Athens / New York, 07 July 2026 – Heidmar Maritime Holdings Corp. (the “Company” or“Heidmar”) (NASDAQ: HMR) today announces that it has completed the acquisition of Q-Shipping B.V., a ship management and crewing business, adding nine vessels to its managed fleet and establishing an operating presence in the Netherlands and Türkiye,with a dedicated crewing capability in Ukraine.[Read More](https://www.heidmar.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/HEIDMAR-July-2026-MARITIME-HOLDINGS-CORP.-EXPANDS-SHIP-MANAGEMENT-PLATFORM-WITH-ENTRY-INTO-DUTCH-AND-TURKISH-MARKETS.pdf)
